If a running command has only printed blank lines so far, the transcript row no longer uses `tool:` as its output and instead keeps its original hint until real content arrives.

items.original:
Keep interrupted command recovery status visible in reopened sessions
A finished `bash_input` call's transcript row now names the shell session it acted on (`Sent input to bash`, `Resized terminal bash session`) instead of a generic `tool operation` subject
A running command whose output so far is only blank lines no longer shows the word `tool:` as its output; the row keeps its hint until real output arrives

title.zh-TW: 背景指令防護與排程任務計數修正
title.en: Background Command Safeguards and Scheduled Task Count Fix

body.zh-TW:
同時開著幾個耗時命令在背後跑，又要小心別誤刪資料夾或漏掉準點執行的紀錄，現在有了對應保護。

只要還有背景指令在某個資料夾裡跑著，想執行會刪掉那個資料夾的指令就會被直接擋下。拒絕訊息還會點名是哪個指令以及怎麼停掉它。

背景指令跑超過 30 分鐘的那次提醒，現在遇到有時限的任務時，會先叫代理把目前最好的結果存到任務指定的位置再繼續等。

用 `code_wait` 等待一個移到背景執行的程式區塊時，會正常拿到完成的結果，不再當成未知或已被取走而拒絕。

排程任務若在慢速交接後才被工作階段接手，現在會計為已送達而非略過，讓重複任務的執行次數與上次執行時間維持準確。
body.en:
When running several long-lived commands in the background at once, you now have safeguards against accidentally deleting folders or missing on-time execution records.

As long as a background command is still running inside a folder, any command that would delete that folder is blocked directly. The refusal message also names that command and explains how to stop it.

The notice sent once a background command runs past 30 minutes now tells the agent, when facing a time-limited task, to save its best result so far to the task's designated location before waiting any longer.

Using `code_wait` to wait on a code cell moved to the background now returns the completed result normally instead of refusing it as unknown or already consumed.

If a scheduled task is accepted by the session only after a slow handoff, it is now counted as delivered rather than skipped, keeping a repeating task's run count and last-run time accurate.

items.original:
The one notice for a background command still running after 30 minutes now tells the agent, when the task has a time limit, to save its best result where the task asks for it before waiting any longer
A scheduled task that the session accepted after a slow handoff is counted as delivered instead of recorded as skipped, so a repeating task's run count and last-run time stay right
`code_wait` on a backgrounded cell returns the completed result instead of refusing the wait as unknown or already consumed
A shell command that would delete the folder a background command is still running in is now refused, and the refusal names that command and how to stop it

title.zh-TW: Workflow 暫停監看與恢復設定修復
title.en: Workflow Pause Monitoring and Recovery Config Fixes

body.zh-TW:
暫停 Workflow 後，無期限監看也會立刻停止，不再讓代理一直等到指令結束。

暫停 Workflow 時，底下代理啟動的無期限 `persistent` 監看也會一併停掉。被暫停的代理會立刻回報已取消，不必等到被監看的指令結束或工作階段關閉。

接續在對話壓縮前就啟動的 V1 Workflow 時，會改為說明只讀壓縮後這段紀錄，不再錯報找不到已存歷史。該次執行仍得重新啟動，整個工作階段則能繼續使用。

在保留的工作階段工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）裡恢復 Workflow 時，會重讀該工作樹的專案 MCP 設定，讓使用者與外掛的 MCP 伺服器保持可用。
body.en:
Pausing a Workflow now immediately stops no-deadline monitoring as well, instead of making the agent wait until the command finishes.

When pausing a Workflow, any no-deadline `persistent` monitor started by its underlying agents is stopped along with it. The paused agent reports as cancelled right away without waiting for the watched command to exit or the session to close.

Resuming a V1 Workflow that started before conversation compaction now explains that it reads only the history from that compaction onward, rather than falsely reporting that saved history is missing. That run still needs to be restarted, while the overall session remains usable.

When recovering a Workflow inside a retained session worktree (a Git feature that opens multiple parallel copies of the same project), it re-reads that worktree's project MCP configuration so user and plugin MCP servers stay available.

items.original:
Pausing a workflow now stops a no-deadline (`persistent`) monitor that one of its agents started, so the paused agent reports as cancelled right away instead of waiting until the watched command exits or the session ends
Resuming a V1 Workflow that started before you compacted the session now explains that Muse reads only the history from that compaction on, instead of saying saved history is missing; such a run still needs a fresh start, and the session stays usable
A workflow recovery that resumes inside a retained session worktree reads that worktree's project MCP configuration again, so user and plugin MCP servers stay available during the recovery instead of all being withheld

title.zh-TW: Workflow 子工作重啟與重播狀態修正
title.en: Workflow Child Restart and Replay Status Fixes

body.zh-TW:
半途按快捷鍵介入或重播跑過的流程，主代理跟介面現在都知道實際跑到第幾次、查出了什麼。

你按 `r` 重啟 Workflow 的某個子工作後，跟你對話的主代理會直接收到通知，知道你重啟了哪一個子工作以及在第幾次嘗試完成，不必只靠子工作自己口述。

把一個 Workflow 取消掉之後，主代理還是會收到已經做完的子工作查到了什麼結果，不會再回報什麼都沒帶回來。

重播已經結束的 Workflow 時，重跑的代理對話裡會繼續顯示正確的嘗試次數，像是 `attempt 2/2`，不再錯顯示成 `attempt 1/1`。
body.en:
When stepping in mid-run with a shortcut or replaying a finished flow, both the main agent and the interface now know the exact attempt count and what was found.

After you restart a Workflow child task with `r`, the main agent you are talking to receives a direct notice telling it which child task you restarted and on which attempt it finished, rather than relying only on the child task's own words.

After cancelling a Workflow, the main agent still receives what the already finished child tasks found, instead of reporting that nothing came back.

When replaying a finished Workflow, the rerun agent's conversation continues to show the correct attempt count, such as `attempt 2/2`, instead of wrongly showing `attempt 1/1`.

items.original:
After you restart a Workflow child with `r`, the agent you are talking to is told which child you restarted and on which attempt it finished, instead of learning it only from the child's own words
After you cancel a Workflow, the agent is told what the children that had already finished found, instead of reporting that nothing came back
After you replay a finished Workflow, a rerun agent's conversation keeps showing its attempt number (for example `attempt 2/2`) instead of `attempt 1/1`

title.zh-TW: 子代理接續指示與失敗提示修正
title.en: Subagent Resume Instructions and Failure Notice Fixes

body.zh-TW:
派出子代理分頭辦事後，無論是接續舊對話還是遇到失敗，交接狀態都變得明確。

接續工作階段時如果換掉了開發者指示，之後新啟動的子代理都會改用新內容，不再沿用一開始開啟工作階段時的舊指示。

子代理還在跑你就先離開、之後再接續工作階段時，主代理會被告知子代理已經取消，對話紀錄也會補上結束列，不會再默默消失。

子代理收尾失敗時，診斷訊息不會再直接蓋到終端機介面的輸入框上。父對話會顯示和結算失敗一樣的提示，原本那行仍會留在重新導向的標準錯誤與本機追蹤檔裡。
body.en:
After dispatching subagents to work in parallel, handoff status is now clear whether you resume an old conversation or run into a failure.

If developer instructions are replaced when resuming a session, any subagents started afterward use the new content instead of keeping the old instructions from when the session first opened.

If you leave while a subagent is still running and resume the session later, the main agent is told the subagent was cancelled and the transcript adds a finished row, instead of the subagent silently disappearing.

When a subagent fails to finish, its diagnostic message no longer overwrites the terminal interface's input box. The parent conversation shows the same notice as a settlement failure, while that original line still remains in redirected standard error and the local trace file.

items.original:
When a session's `developerPrompt` is replaced on resume, subagents started after that now use the new text instead of the text the session started with
A subagent whose finish fails no longer writes its diagnostic over the composer while the TUI owns the terminal; the parent conversation shows the same notice a settlement failure shows, and the line still appears on redirected stderr and in the local trace
After you exit while a subagent is still running and later resume the session, the agent is told the subagent was cancelled and the transcript shows its finished row, instead of the subagent silently vanishing

title.zh-TW: 模型連線重試與串流計量容錯修正
title.en: Model Connection Retries and Streaming Usage Tolerance Fixes

body.zh-TW:
連線外部模型偶爾會碰上過載、斷線或回傳怪資料，現在處理得更果斷。

模型服務短暫回報過載時，第一次重試約 1 秒後就會開始，不再讓這一輪白白卡住一整分鐘。

當 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 OpenRouter 端點對串流請求回傳非 SSE 頁面，或資料流因格式錯誤中斷時，這輪會附上真實協定原因快速失敗。它不會再對同一份壞回應重試到逾時。

有些模型一旦被要求給推理摘要，伺服器就會把工具呼叫旁的進度文字丟掉。該工作階段收到第一次這類回應後就會停要摘要，讓進度文字重新顯示。

OpenAI 或 Anthropic 供應商在完成的一輪裡，若使用量區塊裡的 token 計數缺漏、被寫成字串或有其他異常，回答仍會保留。異常計數會比照 Meta 供應商按 0 處理。
body.en:
Connecting to external models can occasionally hit overload, dropped streams, or odd payloads, and these cases are now handled more decisively.

When the model service briefly reports being overloaded, the first retry starts after about 1 second instead of stalling the turn for a full minute.

When an OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter endpoint replies to a streaming request with a non-SSE page, or a data stream breaks due to malformed data, the turn fails fast with the real protocol reason. It no longer retries the same broken response until the timeout.

For some models, once reasoning summaries are requested, the server drops the progress text beside tool calls. After receiving the first such response, that session stops asking for summaries so the progress text appears again.

On the OpenAI or Anthropic provider, if a finished turn's usage block has a missing, string-typed, or otherwise abnormal token count, the answer is still kept. Abnormal counts are treated as 0, matching the Meta provider.

items.original:
Muse shows the model's progress text beside its tool calls again on models whose server drops it when reasoning summaries are requested; that session stops asking that model for summaries after the first such response
When the model service briefly reports that it is overloaded, the first retry now comes after about a second instead of stalling the turn for a full minute
When an OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter endpoint answers a streaming request with a non-SSE page, or a model stream breaks with malformed data, the run now fails fast with the real protocol reason instead of retrying the same broken response until the timeout
A finished turn on the OpenAI or Anthropic provider is no longer discarded when the provider's usage block has a missing, string-typed, or otherwise odd token count; the answer is kept and the odd count reads as zero, as it already did on the Meta provider

title.zh-TW: muse serve 搜尋模式與警告計算對齊
title.en: muse serve Search Mode and Warning Calculation Alignment

body.zh-TW:
經由 `muse serve` 接續工作階段時，會保留原本記錄好的網頁搜尋模式，不會回來就自動關掉。

啟動時的目錄更新如果比伺服器載入清單早一步完成，`muse serve` 不再拒絕 `model/list` 給的模型，也不會誤收已經拿掉的模型。

`muse serve` 代管的工作階段在計算上下文壓力警告數值時，現在會比照終端機，依照設定好的壓縮門檻與上下文上限來算。
body.en:
Resuming a session through `muse serve` preserves the previously recorded web-search mode instead of turning it off upon return.

If the startup catalog refresh finishes before the server loads its list, `muse serve` no longer rejects models offered by `model/list`, nor does it mistakenly accept models that were removed.

When calculating context-pressure warning values, sessions hosted by `muse serve` now follow the terminal's behavior by computing them from the configured compaction thresholds and context limit.

items.original:
A session resumed over `muse serve` keeps the web-search mode it recorded instead of coming back with web search turned off
`muse serve` no longer refuses a model that `model/list` offers (or accepts one it dropped) when its startup catalog refresh finished before the server installed its catalog
A session hosted by `muse serve` numbers its context-pressure warning under the configured compaction thresholds and context limit, as the terminal does

title.zh-TW: muse exec 輸出與指令列說明修復
title.en: muse exec Output and CLI Help Fixes

body.zh-TW:
拿 `muse exec` 接進自動化腳本跑批次任務，外掛開關、說明和最終輸出的準確度都有改善。

`muse exec` 現在會遵守 `plugins.activation` 設定，被關掉的外掛（包含 `muse-core` 在內）不會再把技能加進執行裡。

`muse exec --json` 結束時就算工作階段還有大批紀錄來不及寫出，輸出也不會被截斷。這能避免後續執行的結果漏掉，甚至拿前一次的結束狀態碼充數。

指令列執行完畢後，如果通知檢查卡住了也不會再扣住結果不放，檢查逾時只會發出一次警告。

`muse --help` 和 `muse exec --help` 裡的 `--reasoning-effort` 說明不再寫成 Meta 限定。預設推理力度是 `high`，或 Meta 提供的最高推理力度檔位；其他供應商的互動工作階段則預設為 `none`。
body.en:
When integrating `muse exec` into automation scripts for batch runs, plugin toggles, help text, and final output accuracy are all improved.

`muse exec` now honors the `plugins.activation` setting, so disabled plugins (including `muse-core`) no longer add their skills to the run.

When `muse exec --json` finishes, output is no longer truncated even if a large batch of session records has not been written out yet. This prevents losing results from later runs or falling back to an earlier run's exit status code.

After a CLI run finishes, a stalled notice check no longer withholds the result, and a check timeout issues only a single warning.

The `--reasoning-effort` help text in `muse --help` and `muse exec --help` no longer describes the setting as Meta-only. The default reasoning effort is `high`, or the highest reasoning-effort tier provided by Meta; interactive sessions on other providers default to `none`.

items.original:
`muse exec` now honors `plugins.activation`: a plugin turned off, including `muse-core`, no longer adds its skills to the run
Prevent a stalled notice check from withholding a completed CLI run result; warn once when the check times out
The `--reasoning-effort` help in `muse --help` and `muse exec --help` no longer calls the setting Meta-only and names both defaults: high (or Meta's top served tier) and none in interactive sessions on other providers
`muse exec --json` no longer cuts its output short when many records were still unwritten as the session finished; the lost lines could include a later run's result, and the exit status then came from an earlier run

title.zh-TW: 外掛掛鉤路徑與追蹤匯出報告修正
title.en: Fixes for Plugin Hook Paths and Trace Export Reports

body.zh-TW:
檢查外掛設定、追查工具紀錄或匯出使用數據，現在給出的路徑與時間都貼近實況。

`muse plugins validate` 與外掛安裝報告遇到掛鉤問題時，會直接點名出錯的那個掛鉤檔而不是指著它的清單檔。無論是不支援的事件、格式錯誤的處理器或被忽略的 `silent` 鍵，報出來的路徑就是該打開修改的檔案。

在 Linux 和 macOS 上，`SKILL.md` 檔案過大的警告會報出實際超過上限多少，不再永遠只寫超出 1 位元組。

`muse trace inspect` 檢查重播舊工具呼叫的請求時，不會再報出由工具名稱造成的位元組差異；不過舊版錄下的工作階段紀錄還是會看到。

`muse export` 報告的工作階段運行時間現在涵蓋整個 Muse 行程，包含啟動與接續在內，不再每個工作階段重新起算。
body.en:
Checking plugin settings, inspecting tool logs, or exporting usage data now gives paths and times that match reality.

When `muse plugins validate` and the plugin install report hit a hook issue, they now name the specific hook file with the problem instead of pointing to its manifest file. Whether it is an unsupported event, a malformed handler, or an ignored `silent` key, the reported path is the file to open and fix.

On Linux and macOS, the warning for an oversized `SKILL.md` file now reports how much it actually exceeds the limit, instead of always saying 1 byte over.

When `muse trace inspect` checks a request that replays earlier tool calls, it no longer reports a byte difference caused by tool names; sessions recorded by an earlier version will still show it, though.

The session uptime reported by `muse export` now covers the entire Muse process, including startup and resume, instead of resetting for each session.

items.original:
On Linux and macOS, a too-large `SKILL.md` warning now says how far over the limit the file really is, instead of always one byte over
`muse plugins validate` and the plugin install report now name the hook file that holds a hook defect (an unsupported event, a malformed handler or an ignored `silent` key) instead of the manifest that points to it, so the reported path is the file to open
`muse trace inspect` no longer reports a byte difference caused by tool names for a request that replays earlier tool calls; sessions recorded by an earlier version still show it
The session uptime that `muse export` reports now covers the whole Muse process, including startup and resume, instead of restarting for each session

title.zh-TW: 工作樹分支衝突與基準參數檢查更清楚
title.en: Clearer Worktree Branch Conflict and Base Flag Checks

body.zh-TW:
準備另開一條工作分支平行寫程式，遇到撞名或基準點對不上時，提示不再含糊帶過。

啟動工作階段工作樹時，要是那個分支已經在別的工作樹被簽出，會直接失敗並點名是哪個工作樹佔著它，不再丟出夾帶原始 Git 訊息的籠統錯誤。

如果用既有分支對應的 ID 建工作樹，你又額外指定了不是該分支末端的 `--worktree-base`，現在會直接拒絕。它會列出分支名稱與後續做法，不再默默開在該分支上卻把參數丟掉。⟦跟租共用車位一樣，以前車位早被開走卻只丟一張「停不下」的模糊紙條，甚至擅自把你預約的時段抹掉；現在直接告訴你誰停在裡面，參數對不上也當場講明怎麼改。⟧
body.en:
When you are about to open another working branch to code in parallel, prompts are no longer vague if a name collides or a base point does not match.

When starting a session worktree, if that branch is already checked out in another worktree, it now fails directly and names the worktree holding it, instead of throwing a generic error that quotes raw Git output.

If you create a worktree for an ID whose branch already exists and you also pass a `--worktree-base` that is not that branch's tip, it is now rejected outright. It lists the branch name and how to proceed, instead of quietly starting on that branch while dropping the flag. ⟦Renting a shared parking spot used to work the same way: if the spot was already taken, you only got a vague "cannot park" note, or your reserved time slot was silently erased; now it tells you straight out who is parked there, and when your parameters do not match, it explains on the spot how to fix them.⟧

items.original:
Starting a session worktree whose branch is already checked out in another worktree now fails with a clear message that names the worktree holding it, instead of a generic setup failure that quoted raw Git output
A session worktree created for an id whose branch already exists refuses an explicit `--worktree-base` that is not that branch's tip, naming the branch and the ways on, instead of starting on the branch and dropping the flag

title.zh-TW: Windows 與 Linux 沙盒與行程修復
title.en: Windows and Linux Sandbox and Process Fixes

body.zh-TW:
Windows 與 Linux 使用者執行隔離指令或關掉背景 PowerShell，環境銜接與掃尾更完整。

Windows 上的 `muse serve` 與 `muse acp`，只要沙盒設定完成就能正常跑沙盒指令，不再報錯 `"setup has not run"`。而 `muse serve` 也會正確回報沙盒可用。

同樣在 Windows，在沒開沙盒也沒有 `tty` 的情況下停止背景 PowerShell 工作階段時，它所啟動的其他程式也會一併結束，就算外殼本身早就先退出了也一樣。

Linux 上的沙盒指令現在只會定位一次佔位登錄位置，就算啟動當下才冒出個人執行期目錄，也不會讓原本禁止的路徑失去保護，或誤擋同一位使用者的其他沙盒指令。
body.en:
For Windows and Linux users running isolated commands or closing background PowerShell sessions, environment handoff and cleanup are now more thorough.

On Windows, `muse serve` and `muse acp` can now run sandboxed commands normally once sandbox setup is complete, instead of failing with `"setup has not run"`. `muse serve` also correctly reports that the sandbox is available.

Also on Windows, stopping a background PowerShell session running without the sandbox and without `tty` now also ends the other programs it started, even if the shell itself already exited earlier.

On Linux, a sandboxed command now locates its placeholder registry only once, so even if a per-user runtime directory appears while it is starting up, it will no longer leave denied paths unprotected or mistakenly block other sandboxed commands from the same user.

items.original:
On Windows, sandboxed shell commands in `muse serve` and `muse acp` now run once sandbox setup is complete, instead of failing with "setup has not run", and `muse serve` reports the sandbox as available
On Windows, stopping a background PowerShell session run without the sandbox and without `tty` now also ends the programs it started, including after its shell already exited
On Linux, a sandboxed command now finds its placeholder registry once, so a per-user runtime directory that appears while the command is starting no longer leaves one of its denied paths unprotected or refuses another sandboxed command of the same user

title.zh-TW: 舊對話歷史清理與延後寫入省硬碟
title.en: Old History Cleanup and Deferred Writes Save Disk Space

body.zh-TW:
用久了擔心對話歷史檔把硬碟塞滿，現在舊檔會自動清掉、新檔也改為需要時才建。

舊版本留在工作階段資料夾裡的訊息歷史資料庫檔案，現在會在背景自動清除來騰出空間。

舊版 Muse 為工作階段保存的歷史複本，只要連續 7 天沒有寫入且沒有任何 Muse 開著該工作階段，也會自動從硬碟刪除。

從終端機或 `muse exec` 開起的工作階段更省空間：給桌面版用的歷史紀錄改在桌面版第一次打開該工作階段時才建立，不再每輪都寫。在此之前，終端機還開著的對話在桌面版不會顯示歷史。⟦打掃舊儲藏室時，以前搬家留下的舊箱子一放就是好幾年，每次寫筆記還先多複印一份給別間辦公室；現在逾期沒用的舊箱子會自動清掉，複印本也等對方真的來拿才印。⟧
body.en:
If you worry that conversation history files will fill up your disk over time, old files are now cleared automatically and new ones are only created when needed.

Message history database files left in session folders by earlier versions are now automatically removed in the background to free up space.

History copies saved for a session by older Muse versions are also automatically deleted from disk once they go 7 days without a write and no Muse instance has that session open.

Sessions started from the terminal or with `muse exec` use less space: the history for the desktop app is now created only the first time the desktop app opens that session, instead of being written on every turn. Until then, conversations still open in the terminal will not show history in the desktop app. ⟦Cleaning out an old storeroom used to leave boxes from past moves sitting around for years, and every time you wrote a note you printed an extra copy for another office; now unused overdue boxes are cleared out automatically, and extra copies are only printed when the other side actually comes to pick them up.⟧

items.original:
Session-message history database files that earlier versions left in session folders are removed in the background, which frees disk space
Muse now removes the saved history that an older Muse version kept for a session once that copy has gone 7 days without a write and no Muse has the session open, which used to stay on disk
A session started in the terminal or with `muse exec` takes less disk: its history for the desktop app is built the first time the desktop app opens the session instead of being written at every turn (until then the desktop app shows no history for a session a terminal still has open)

title.zh-TW: 無異動的掛鉤空跑不再寫入紀錄檔
title.en: No-Op Hook Runs No Longer Write to Session Logs

body.zh-TW:
掛鉤裝多了，以前就算什麼也沒改動也要寫進工作階段紀錄檔佔空間。

工具呼叫後、整批工具呼叫後或子代理啟動時跑的掛鉤，只要結束碼是 0、標準錯誤只有空白、沒有系統訊息、沒有錯誤也沒有任何效果，就算有印出標準輸出也不再留紀錄。其他情況會在結束時記錄。

送出提問時觸發的掛鉤，結束碼為 0、標準錯誤只有空白，且沒有新增上下文、攔截、改寫、系統訊息或錯誤，才不留紀錄。略過這些無異動紀錄能省下硬碟空間，其餘照舊記錄。⟦就像大廈警衛巡邏簽到，以前每經過一扇鎖得好好的門也要寫一張長報告；現在一切安好就不必浪費紙張，真有開門或異狀才落筆登記。⟧
body.en:
With many hooks installed, they used to write to the session log and take up space even when they changed nothing.

Hooks that run after a tool call, after a batch of tool calls, or when a subagent starts no longer leave a record if they exit with code 0, write only whitespace to stderr, have no system message, have no error, and have no effect, even if they print to stdout. All other cases are recorded when they finish.

Hooks triggered when a prompt is submitted are omitted from the log only when they exit with code 0, write only whitespace to stderr, and have no added context, block, rewrite, system message, or error. Skipping these no-op records saves disk space, while everything else is logged as before. ⟦A building security guard on patrol used to write a long report for every locked door passed; now, when everything is fine, no paper is wasted, and a log entry is only written down when a door is opened or something looks off.⟧

items.original:
A hook that runs after a tool call, after a batch of tool calls or when a subagent starts no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr, returns no system message, has no error and has no effect, even if it prints to stdout, so sessions with many hooks take less disk; any other run of these hooks is recorded when it ends
A hook that runs when a prompt is submitted no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr and adds or changes nothing (no context, block, rewrite, system message or error), so sessions with many prompt hooks take less disk; any other run of these hooks is recorded as before

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段與接續執行減少記憶體佔用
title.en: Lower Memory Usage for Long Sessions and Resumes

body.zh-TW:
一個對話越聊越長，或是打開從沒整理過的龐大舊紀錄，程式吃掉的記憶體量降下來了。

進行中的工作階段保存在記憶體裡的每筆事件紀錄都變小了，長對話更省資源。

接續一個從未壓縮過的長工作階段時，解碼出來的紀錄複本會在重建工作階段狀態前先釋放，記憶體峰值跟著降低。

子代理畫面不再記住它顯示過的每一筆事件。

顯示層也不再把前面各輪的任務活動日誌一路帶進每一輪新對話裡。⟦跑長途馬拉松時，以前把沿路喝空的紙杯和看過的路標全塞在背包裡；現在邊跑邊把不需要的舊紙屑清掉，步伐自然輕省不少。⟧
body.en:
As a conversation grows longer, or when opening a massive old log that was never compacted, the program now uses less memory.

Each event record that an active session keeps in memory is now smaller, making long conversations lighter on resources.

When resuming a long session that was never compacted, the decoded copy of the log is released before rebuilding the session state, lowering peak memory usage.

The subagent view no longer remembers every event it has displayed.

The display layer also no longer carries the task activity journal from earlier turns into each new turn. ⟦Running a long marathon used to mean stuffing every empty paper cup and road sign you passed into your backpack; now you clear out unneeded scraps as you run, making every step noticeably lighter.⟧

items.original:
Long sessions use less memory, because each event record the live session keeps in memory is smaller
Resuming a long session that was never compacted peaks at less memory, because the decoded copy of its log is released before the session's state is rebuilt
Long sessions use less memory, because the subagent view no longer remembers every event it has shown
Long sessions use less memory, because the display no longer carries its journal of earlier turns' task activity into each new turn

title.zh-TW: SDK 連線檢查與工作階段協定更新
title.en: SDK Connection Checks and Session Protocol Updates

body.zh-TW:
開發者把自家工具接上這套引擎時，連線前的版本相容檢查與任務結束後的摘要整理，這版都做了調整。

啟動 TypeScript SDK 連線時，現在可以設定拒絕連上宣告過破壞性協定變動的主機；預設仍會照常連線，並提供方法回報差異的層級。

工作階段協定的完成紀錄與指令列項目可附上順序位置資訊，用來維持完成時的排列順序。

背景任務、監看或排程結束後透過 SDK 要求摘要時，現在會總結那件剛完成的任務，不再誤拿你更早以前的訊息來摘要。

工作階段協定在接續發生錯誤時，不會再把已經修復過的紀錄檔說成未曾修改。
body.en:
When developers connect their own tools to this engine, both pre-connection version compatibility checks and post-task summaries have been updated in this release.

When starting a TypeScript SDK connection, you can now configure it to refuse connecting to a host that has declared a breaking protocol change; by default it still connects normally and provides a method to report the mismatch tier.

Session protocol completion records and shell items can include ordering position information to preserve completion order.

When requesting a recap through the SDK after a background task, monitor, or scheduled task finishes, it now summarizes that newly completed task instead of mistakenly summarizing your earlier message.

When an error occurs during resume, the session protocol no longer claims that a repaired log file was unchanged.

items.original:
The TypeScript SDK can refuse to connect to a host whose protocol schema moved by a declared breaking change: pass `refuseDeclaredBreakingSchema: true` when spawning; by default the connection goes ahead and `classifyServedSchema(initializeResult.schema)` names the mismatch's tier
Session protocol completion and shell items can include `terminalRowBeforeItemId` to preserve completion order
A recap requested through the SDKs after a background task, monitor or scheduled task finishes now summarizes that work instead of your earlier message
Session protocol resume errors no longer claim a repaired log was unchanged

title.zh-TW: 自動審查不再另存自己的對話紀錄
title.en: Auto-review no longer saves a separate conversation log

items.original: Sessions take less disk space: Auto-review no longer saves a separate log file of the reviewer's own conversation. To keep those logs, set `approval_judge.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 未信任資料夾會提示專案 MCP 工具未載入
title.en: Untrusted folders now show when project MCP tools are not loaded

body.zh-TW:
接手別人傳來的陌生專案資料夾，執行指令卻發現裡面設好的工具全都沒動靜。在未受信任的資料夾裡，寫在 `.mcp.json` 中的專案 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器預設不會載入。

現在執行 `muse exec` 時，畫面會直接說明這些專案伺服器未載入以及如何載入。改跑 `muse mcp list` 查看清單，也會交代未載入的原因和載入做法。

⟦打開陌生朋友傳來的試算表，以前裡面的巨集按鈕按下去毫無反應，現在頂端會直接跳出提醒，告訴你為什麼被擋下、按哪裡就能啟用。⟧
body.en:
When you take over an unfamiliar project folder from someone else and run a command, the tools configured inside may sit completely idle. In an untrusted folder, project MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers defined in `.mcp.json` are not loaded by default.

Now when you run `muse exec`, it directly tells you that these project servers were not loaded and how to load them. Running `muse mcp list` to inspect the list also explains why they were not loaded and how to load them.

⟦Picture opening a spreadsheet sent by a new acquaintance: previously clicking its macro buttons did nothing at all, whereas now a banner pops up at the top explaining why it was blocked and where to click to enable it.⟧

items.original: In an untrusted folder, `muse exec` now says that project MCP servers in `.mcp.json` were not loaded and how to load them, and `muse mcp list` says why and how to load them

title.zh-TW: 透過服務或開發套件開的旁支對話從空白開始
title.en: Side chats opened via the service or SDKs start empty

body.zh-TW:
在一段對話中途想另開旁支話題，以前常一打開就夾帶著整串前情提要。現在透過 `muse serve` 或 TypeScript、Python SDK（軟體開發套件）開啟的新旁支對話，會直接從空白開始，不再顯示原本那場對話的內容。

不過，在這次更新前就已經開好的旁支對話不受影響，依然會顯示原本的對話輪次；只要它還開著，工作階段清單也還是會把這些輪次算進去。

⟦討論到一半想另開小房間私聊，以前走進去牆上都掛著大廳剛才講過的話，現在裡面是一片乾淨的白板，更新前就開著的小房間則維持原樣。⟧
body.en:
When you want to branch off into a side topic mid-conversation, opening one used to bring along the entire preceding thread. New side chats opened through `muse serve` or the TypeScript and Python SDKs (developer toolkits) now start empty instead of showing the content of the original conversation.

However, side chats that were already open before this update are unaffected and still show the original conversation turns; as long as they remain open, the session list still counts those turns.

⟦When you step into a breakout room for a private chat mid-discussion, the walls used to be covered with everything just said in the main hall, but now there is a clean whiteboard inside, while rooms opened before the update stay as they were.⟧

items.original: A side chat opened through `muse serve` or the TypeScript and Python SDKs now starts empty instead of showing the turns of the conversation it came from (side chats opened before this update still show those turns and, while open, count them in the session list)

title.zh-TW: 新工作階段寫不進紀錄會先停下報錯
title.en: New sessions stop with an error if the log cannot be written

body.zh-TW:
剛開一個新工作階段送出第一句話，最怕模型已經開始跑，紀錄檔卻沒存下來。現在只要工作階段紀錄寫不進這第一筆模型請求，這一輪就會直接停住並回報可重試的儲存錯誤，不會呼叫模型。等到寫入成功，這筆請求就會存進紀錄。

⟦錄音室開錄新節目，以前錄音帶還沒開始轉就先讓來賓開講，現在確定錄音機寫得進去才開麥，寫不進去就先喊停讓你重試。⟧
body.en:
Right after starting a new session and sending your first message, the worst surprise is having the model start running while the log file fails to save. Now, if the session log cannot write this first model request, the turn stops immediately with a retryable storage error instead of calling the model. Once the write succeeds, the request is saved to the log.

⟦At a recording studio starting a new show, the guest used to begin speaking before the tape was even rolling, whereas now the mic only turns on once the recorder confirms it can write—if it cannot, the session pauses and lets you retry.⟧

items.original: If the session log can't save a new session's first model request, the turn now stops with a retryable storage error instead of calling the model; the request is saved once the write succeeds

title.zh-TW: 讀取與恢復長工作階段省資源又能取回紀錄
title.en: Reading and resuming long sessions saves resources and retrieves records

body.zh-TW:
在長工作階段裡讀檔與接續對話，過去常因為重複讀取和複製而多耗資源。

對串接介面的開發者來說，讀取或恢復長工作階段時，若只取中繼資料（描述工作階段的資訊，不含對話內容），現在需要的處理更少。若已存的歷史紀錄超過讀取上限，也不會只回傳超限結果，而是能取回待處理的請求與最後一輪對話。

從未壓縮過的工作階段，如果在恢復後緊接著再讀取一次，現在不會重頭讀完整份紀錄檔，只會讀取恢復那一步新增的內容。

恢復沒有儲存檢查點（紀錄進度的存檔點）的長工作階段時，啟動過程中佔用的記憶體也變少，因為起始紀錄不會再為每個讀取它的部分各複製一份。
body.en:
Reading files and continuing conversations in long sessions used to consume extra resources due to repeated reads and copying.

For developers integrating with the interface, reading or resuming a long session now requires less processing when requesting only metadata (information describing the session, without conversation content). If the saved history exceeds the read limit, instead of returning only an over-limit result, it can now retrieve pending requests and the last turn.

For a session that has never been compacted, reading it again right after resuming no longer reads the entire log file from the start; it only reads what the resume step added.

Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint (a save point that records progress) also uses less memory during startup, because the starting records are no longer copied once for each part that reads them.

items.original:
A metadata-only `session/read` or `session/resume` (`excludeItems`) does less work on long sessions; a session whose saved history is over the read cap now gets its pending requests and last turn back instead of `noneReason: "projectionReadLimit"`
A `session/read` right after `session/resume` no longer reads the whole log again for a session that never compacted; it reads only what the resume added
Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint uses less memory while it starts, because the records it starts from are no longer copied once for each part of the session that reads them

title.zh-TW: 修正重啟工作階段會漏掉最後一輪的問題
title.en: Fix restarting a session dropping the last turn

body.zh-TW: 最新那筆訊息剛好重複了前面已結束輪次的指示或規則。以前遇到這種情況，重啟工作階段會把這最後一輪直接漏掉。這個問題已經修好，現在重啟工作階段後仍會保留這一輪，不再把它丟掉。
body.en: When the most recent message happens to repeat the instructions or rules of an earlier, finished turn, restarting the session used to drop this final turn completely. This issue has been fixed, so restarting the session now preserves the turn instead of discarding it.

items.original: Restarting a session no longer drops its most recent turn when that turn repeats the instructions or rules of an earlier, finished turn

title.zh-TW: 修正取消工作流程誤報子任務被中止
title.en: Fix cancelling a workflow misreporting child tasks as killed

body.zh-TW: 執行到一半手動喊停後，清單上會列出這次一起停掉的背景作業。以前回報的結果裡，會把子任務自己的任務也當成該子任務被中止的背景任務報出來。這個問題已經修好，現在取消工作流程不再出現這筆誤報。
body.en: After manually stopping a run midway, the list shows the background jobs that were stopped along with it. Previously, the reported results mistakenly listed a child task's own task as one of that child's killed background tasks. This issue has been fixed, so cancelling a workflow no longer produces this false report.

items.original: Cancelling a workflow no longer reports a child's own task as one of that child's killed background tasks

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux 沙盒指令留下空佔位資料夾
title.en: Fix Linux sandboxed commands leaving empty placeholder folders

body.zh-TW: 打開 Linux 上的專案目錄，偶爾會莫名出現一個空的佔位資料夾。這發生在沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境）指令遺失佔位紀錄的情況，過去即使共用它的指令跑完了，這個空資料夾還是會留著。這個問題已經修好，現在共用它的指令結束後不會再殘留空資料夾。
body.en: Opening a project directory on Linux would occasionally reveal an unexplained empty placeholder folder. This happened when a sandbox (an isolated, secure environment) command lost its placeholder bookkeeping, leaving the empty folder behind even after the command sharing it had finished. This issue has been fixed, so no empty placeholder folder remains once the command sharing it ends.

items.original: On Linux, a sandboxed command whose placeholder bookkeeping was lost no longer leaves an empty placeholder folder in your project once the command sharing it has finished

title.zh-TW: 面板新增「絨毛小夥伴」主題
title.en: New "Plush Pals" Panel Theme

body.zh-TW:
查看用量想少點枯燥，現在有動物陪你看額度。到 **⚙ 設定 → 切換面板** 選「絨毛小夥伴」，共 18 種主題，固定亮色不受系統深淺影響。米白卡片配咖啡縫邊，底下 11 個原創絨毛角色散步，點選看名字，偶爾聊天打盹。

每條額度進度條站一位角色，停在目前百分比。5 小時與週額度較近上限那條用到 80% 會緊張，用完睡著，重置時醒來歡呼。

小夥伴只在要緊時出泡泡，一次一個：額度到 80%、用完與重置，或睡著後重置前約 10 分鐘伸懶腰。現速將提前用完會報剩餘時間，並推薦有空位的工具。Claude 或 Codex 回報故障及恢復時也會出現泡泡。今日用量超昨天整排歡呼，過半夜也有泡泡。每天首次造訪時，依週額度剛重置、隔幾天回來、週一或週五，或當下時段換招呼。12 月飄雪，隊尾日換一棵毛氈聖誕樹。

⟦過去只盯數字，現在公仔見底打盹、補滿歡呼。⟧
body.en:
To make checking usage less dry, animals now keep you company while you watch your quotas. Go to **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel** and pick "Plush Pals", one of 18 themes, fixed in its light look regardless of system appearance. Cream cards with brown stitched edges sit above 11 original plush characters strolling along; click one to see its name, and now and then they chat or doze off.

One character stands on each quota bar at its current percentage. Between the 5-hour and weekly quotas, the one closer to its limit looks worried at 80%, falls asleep when it runs out, and wakes up cheering when it resets.

The pals only show speech bubbles when it matters, one at a time: when a quota hits 80%, runs out, or resets, or when a sleeping pal stretches about 10 minutes before reset. If the current pace will empty a quota early, it reports the time left and recommends a tool that still has room. Bubbles also appear when Claude or Codex reports an outage or recovers. When today's usage passes yesterday's, the whole row cheers, and there is a bubble after midnight too. On each day's first visit, the greeting adapts to a freshly reset weekly quota, returning after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day. In December, snow falls, and a different felt Christmas tree stands at the end of the line each day.

⟦Picture staring only at numbers before, whereas now plushies doze off at empty and cheer when refilled.⟧

items.original: **New panel theme: Plush Pals.** Cream cards with a brown stitched rim, and eleven original plush animals that stroll along a row under the cards. One pal sits on each quota bar at its current percentage; it looks worried from 80% and falls asleep when the quota runs out (whichever of the 5-hour and weekly quotas is closer to the limit), and wakes up cheering when it resets. The pals speak up only when it matters, one speech bubble at a time: when a quota reaches 80%, runs out or resets; when a sleeping pal's quota is about 10 minutes from resetting (it stretches); when the current pace would empty a quota early (saying how long is left, and which other tool still has room); when Claude or Codex reports an outage and when it recovers; when today's usage passes yesterday's (the line cheers); on the day's first visit, with a greeting that fits (a weekly quota that just reset, a return after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day); and after midnight. Now and then two pals in line chat or one dozes off. In December snow falls across the panel and a felt Christmas tree, a different one each day, stands at its end. Click a pal to see its name. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 18 themes. The panel always uses its light look, whatever the system appearance.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式選詞更準並可單獨標懂名詞
title.en: Beginner Mode Picks Better Terms and Marks Them One by One

body.zh-TW:
用新手模式學名詞，以前只懂一兩個詞卻得按 9 全標，還常被無關的檔名或路徑佔掉三個提示位置。現在按 4～6 就能單獨標懂對應的那一個名詞，按 9 照舊三個一起標。分支名稱、檔名、路徑、單獨數字與 PR（請求把修改併回主線）編號不再佔位，每個提示也都會真的出現在 Claude 的回答裡。

同一概念的兩種寫法現在也算同一個詞。標過「分支」或「branch」懂了，兩者就不再當新詞提示；標過「PR」或「Pull Request」懂了，「PR」和「pull request」也不會再跳出。上述詞彙只要自己打出任一種寫法，就算你會了。

⟦以前背詞像整串鑰匙一起收、還常夾進門牌號，現在能拆開單獨收好，同一把的中英文兩把也只要認得一支就算過關。⟧
body.en:
When learning terms in Beginner Mode, you previously had to press 9 to mark all three even if you only knew one or two, and unrelated file names or paths often took up the three hint slots. Now pressing 4–6 marks just the corresponding term understood, while 9 still marks all three. Branch names, file names, paths, bare numbers, and PR (pull request) numbers no longer take up slots, and every hint actually appears in Claude's reply.

Two names for the same concept now count as one term. Once you mark "分支" or "branch" understood, neither appears as a new hint; once you mark "PR" or "Pull Request" understood, "PR" and "pull request" stop popping up too. Typing either form of those terms yourself counts as knowing it.

⟦Think of studying terms before like putting away a whole keyring with house numbers mixed in; now you can unclip and store each key on its own, and recognizing either the Chinese or English copy of the same key counts.⟧

items.original:
**Beginner Mode lets you mark terms one at a time and skips project names.** Press 4–6 to mark a single term understood; 9 still marks all three. Branch names, PR numbers, file names, paths and bare numbers no longer take the three hint slots, and every hint must appear in Claude's answer.
**Beginner Mode treats two names for one idea as one term.** Once you mark "分支（branch）" or "PR（Pull Request）" understood, "branch", "分支", "PR" and "pull request" stop appearing as new hints, and typing either name counts as knowing it.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式紀錄保存與提示比對更可靠
title.en: Beginner Mode Saves Progress and Matches Hints More Reliably

body.zh-TW:
多視窗存檔打架與解答斷句這類新手模式的小狀況，現在都有解了。

兩個對話同時存檔時，每次改動都在存檔前一刻重讀名詞紀錄，較不會弄丟「懂了」。紀錄讀不到時不再先請 Haiku 挑詞，5 小時額度的暫停改看該額度自己的讀取與重置時間。

白話解釋改請 Haiku 寫出完整短句，長度上限加倍到 80 個字元，不再被切成半句。之前存成半句的解釋，下次那個詞再出現時會換成完整版。

用一種寫法學會的詞，不論先遇到哪種寫法，換另一種都不會再回來。回答只有 `RAPID` 字樣時不再算出現 `API`，`PR #42`、Windows 路徑與 `fix/test` 分支名也不再佔位。Haiku 在清單前多寫一句話時，缺欄位的單一詞彙不再連累其他詞消失，每則回答讀名詞紀錄的次數也變少。

現在多視窗並行時，標記較不易漏存、解釋看得到整句，提示也只留回答真正用到的詞。
body.en:
Small Beginner Mode hiccups like competing window saves and cut-off explanations are now fixed.

When two conversations save at once, each change re-reads the term list right before saving so "understood" marks are less likely to be lost. When the list is unreadable, it no longer asks Haiku for terms first, and the 5-hour quota pause now follows that quota's own reading and reset times.

Plain-language explanations now ask Haiku for a complete short sentence, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters so they are no longer cut in half. Any explanation saved half-finished is replaced with the full version the next time that term appears.

A term learned under one spelling never comes back under the other, whichever you saw first. Replies containing only `RAPID` no longer count as showing `API`, and `PR #42`, Windows paths, and `fix/test` branch names no longer take up slots. When Haiku adds a line of preamble before the list, a single term with a missing field no longer causes the other terms to disappear, and each reply reads the term list fewer times.

Now when multiple windows run in parallel, marks are less likely to drop, explanations show full sentences, and hints keep only the terms the reply actually uses.

items.original:
**Beginner Mode loses fewer "understood" marks when two conversations save at once.** Each change now re-reads the term list right before saving. It also stops asking Haiku for terms while the term list is unreadable, and the 5-hour pause now follows that quota's own reading time and reset.
**Beginner Mode explanations are no longer cut off mid-sentence.** Haiku is asked for a complete short phrase, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters. An explanation saved half-finished is replaced the next time its term comes up.
**Beginner Mode hints only what the answer really uses.** A term learned under one name no longer comes back under its other name, whichever came first. `API` no longer counts as appearing just because the answer says `RAPID`. PR numbers like `PR #42`, Windows paths and branch names such as `fix/test` no longer take hint slots, and one malformed term after a line of preamble no longer drops the others. Each reply also reads the term list fewer times.

title.zh-TW: 所有面板的按鈕與用量單位顯示修正
title.en: Button and Usage Unit Display Fixes Across All Panels

body.zh-TW:
以前看著面板上的數字和按鈕，有時會搞不清統計幾天或單位是什麼。每個面板的專案範圍按鈕現在都改成 `今日 ⇄`，跟 Antigravity 的 `Gemini ⇄` 一致，讓人一眼看得出點下去會依序切到今日、昨日、7 日、月和全部。

v0.5.0 把面板換成網頁版面後，專案與今日總量旁的單位一度消失。現在完整數字後面都會補上較小較淡的 `tokens`（AI 計算用量的文字單位），例如 `567,641 tokens`，數字維持精確不縮寫。最窄的面板把專案名稍微縮小，九位數旁也放得下 13 個字元的名稱。

以前隱藏 Claude Code 後，「設定」按鈕移到下一張卡卻緊貼標題，在 Antigravity 卡上則黏在 Gemini 按鈕旁。現在它會跟在 Claude Code 卡上一樣，靠在最右邊。
body.en:
Looking at the numbers and buttons in a panel used to leave you unsure how many days were counted or what the unit was. Every panel's project range button now reads `Today ⇄`, matching the Antigravity `Gemini ⇄` button, so you can tell at a glance that clicking it steps through Today, Yesterday, 7 Days, Month, and All Time.

After v0.5.0 switched the panels to a web layout, the unit next to project and daily totals went missing. Every full count is now followed by a smaller, quieter `tokens` (text units AI uses to measure usage), such as `567,641 tokens`, while the numbers stay exact and un-abbreviated. The narrowest panels shrink the project name slightly so a 13-character name still fits beside a nine-digit count.

Previously, hiding Claude Code moved the Settings button to the next card right up against the title, or right next to the Gemini button on the Antigravity card. It now stays at the far right edge, just as it does on the Claude Code card.

items.original:
**Every panel shows that the project range button cycles.** The button reads `Today ⇄`, matching the Antigravity `Gemini ⇄` button, so it is clear that clicking it steps through Today, Yesterday, 7 Days, Month and All Time.
**Token counts in the panel show their unit again.** The `tokens` unit next to project and daily totals went missing when the panels moved to HTML in v0.5.0, so numbers like `567,641` had no label. Every panel now shows the full count followed by a smaller, quieter `tokens`, for example `567,641 tokens`. Counts stay exact and are never abbreviated. In the narrowest panels the project name is slightly smaller, so a 13-character name still fits beside a nine-digit count.
**The settings button stays at the right edge of the card.** Before this fix, hiding Claude Code moved the button to the next card but left it right after the card title, or right after the Gemini button on the Antigravity card. It now sits at the right edge, as it does on the Claude Code card.

title.zh-TW: Windows 95 面板字級與長條調整
title.en: Windows 95 Panel Text Sizes and Bar Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 95 面板上，以前卡片標題竟比底下的列還小，`Gemini ⇄` 按鈕也比標題列其他按鈕小一號。現在六種字級收成三種，卡片標題、列標題、百分比和今日總計都是 15 px（像素，螢幕上的點數單位）。專案列、速率列和所有按鈕改成 13 px，重置時間、金額和署名則是 11 px。

專案長條也從原本的 3 px 拉高到 8 px，第一名則是 9 px。以前 3 px 扣掉立體邊框只剩約 1 px 綠色，根本比不出長短，現在一眼就分得出高下。⟦就像把字體大小亂跳、進度條細成一條線的手寫帳本，重新劃好大中小三種格線並塗粗長條，哪項花最多立刻分明。⟧
body.en:
In the Windows 95 panel, card titles used to be smaller than the rows below them, and the `Gemini ⇄` button was a size smaller than the other title-bar buttons. Six text sizes are now consolidated into three: card titles, row labels, percentages, and the daily total are 15 px (pixels, the dot units on a screen). Project rows, the rate line, and all buttons are 13 px, while reset times, costs, and the credit line are 11 px.

Project bars also grew from 3 px to 8 px tall, and 9 px for the top project. Previously, subtracting the beveled border from 3 px left only about 1 px of green, making it impossible to compare lengths, whereas now you can tell them apart at a glance. ⟦Picture a handwritten ledger with erratic font sizes and hairline progress bars being redrawn with neat large, medium, and small rulings and thick bars, so the biggest expense stands out immediately.⟧

items.original:
**The Windows 95 panel uses three text sizes instead of six.** Card titles, row labels, percentages and the daily total are 15 px; project rows, the rate line and every button are 13 px; reset times, costs and the credit line are 11 px. Before this, card titles were smaller than the rows below them, and the `Gemini ⇄` button was smaller than the other title-bar buttons.
**Project bars in the Windows 95 panel are easier to compare.** They were 3 px tall, and the beveled border left about 1 px of green. They are now 8 px tall, 9 px for the top project.

title.zh-TW: 復古報紙等四款面板風格與間距統一
title.en: Unified Style and Spacing for Four Panels Including Newspaper

body.zh-TW:
這幾款主題面板過去有些零件跟周圍畫風不太搭，或上下擠成一團，現在都比照同張卡的元件對齊了。

在復古報紙面板裡，專案長條原本是圓角細條，現在改成跟額度長條一樣的方角細框。`Gemini ⇄` 按鈕也從膠囊形改成跟「設定」一致的方角，Antigravity 圖示則加上灰色方塊底，比照 Claude Code 圖示。

稜鏡街機面板的專案用量卡片以前只用字母 `P` 頂著，像還沒畫完的佔位符號。現在換成資料夾裡有幾根小長條的圖示，並放進跟 Antigravity、Grok 同款的徽章裡。

雲朵觀測、水族箱與稜鏡街機面板的底部卡片也變寬鬆了。速率列和今日總計原本離中間分隔線只有 5 px，現在上下各拉開到 8 px，跟按鈕上方的間距一致。
body.en:
Several themed panels used to have parts that clashed with their surroundings or felt cramped vertically, and they are now aligned with the rest of each card.

In the Newspaper panel, project bars used to be thin rounded strips and now use the same square, outlined track as the quota bars. The `Gemini ⇄` button switched from pill-shaped to square like the Settings button, and the Antigravity icon now sits on a gray square like the Claude Code icon.

The Prism Arcade panel's project usage card used to show just the letter `P`, looking like an unfinished placeholder. It now displays a folder with small bars inside, placed in the same badge style as the Antigravity and Grok icons.

The bottom card in the Cloud Observation, Aquarium, and Prism Arcade panels also has more breathing room. The rate line and daily total used to sit just 5 px from the center divider, and the gap is now 8 px on both sides, matching the space above the buttons.

items.original:
**The Newspaper panel looks like one design.** Project bars were thin rounded strips; they now use the same square, outlined track as the quota bars. The `Gemini ⇄` button is square like the settings button instead of pill-shaped, and the Antigravity icon sits on a gray square like the Claude Code icon.
**The bottom card in the Cloud Observation, Aquarium and Prism Arcade panels has more room.** The rate line and the daily total sat 5 px from the divider between them; the gap is now 8 px on each side, matching the space above the buttons.
**The Prism Arcade project card has an icon instead of the letter `P`.** It now shows a folder with small bars, in the same badge as the Antigravity and Grok icons, so it no longer looks like a placeholder.

title.zh-TW: 面板文字與按鈕不再被遮擋或融成一片
title.en: Panel Text and Buttons No Longer Covered or Blending In

body.zh-TW:
背景配色淡到看不清，或裝飾線條壓到卡片內容，讀起數據就會很吃力。雲朵觀測面板的 `Gemini ⇄` 按鈕原本淡紫到在白色玻璃卡上幾乎消失，現在改用跟 Antigravity 圖示同款的深紫色。圖示圓底也從半透明白改成淡紫色，不再融進卡片。

心電監視器面板的額度長條原本離重置時間那行只有 2 px，80% 刻度還會頂到文字，現在間距拉開到 6 px。

摺紙面板第一名徽章曾是一半淺一半深，讓白色的 `1` 消失，現在改成兩種深藍。卡片右下角摺角也縮小且只在尖端保留深色，讓重置時間、百分比和金額都落在淺色紙面上。

蝶類圖鑑面板的蝴蝶飛過卡片中段時不透明度曾達 85%，線條會壓住重置時間、「設定」按鈕和狀態列。現在最高降到約 45%，蝴蝶照樣飛過卡片，底下的字卻看得清楚。
body.en:
Reading data gets hard when background colors fade out or decorative lines cross over card content. In the Cloud Observation panel, the `Gemini ⇄` button used to be such a pale purple that it nearly vanished on the white glass card, and it now uses the same deep purple as the Antigravity icon. The icon's backing circle also changed from translucent white to light purple so it no longer blends into the card.

In the Heart Monitor panel, the quota bars used to sit only 2 px below the reset time line, with the 80% tick poking into the text; the gap is now 6 px.

The Origami panel's first-place badge used to be half light and half dark, causing the white `1` to disappear, and is now two shades of deep blue. The folded corner at the bottom right of each card is also smaller and dark only at the tip, keeping reset times, percentages, and costs on light paper.

In the Lepidoptera panel, butterflies flying across the middle of the cards used to reach 85% opacity, covering reset times, the Settings button, and the status line with their outlines. Their peak opacity is now down to about 45%, so they still fly across the cards while the text underneath stays clear.

items.original:
**The Antigravity header in the Cloud Observation panel is easier to read.** The `Gemini ⇄` button used a pale purple that nearly disappeared on the white glass card; it now uses the same deep purple as the Antigravity icon. The icon's backing circle, which was translucent white, is now light purple, so it no longer blends into the card.
**The Heart Monitor panel's quota bars no longer touch the reset time.** The bar sat 2 px below the reset line, and its 80% tick rose into the text. The gap is now 6 px.
**The Origami panel no longer hides text under its dark folds.** The first-place rank badge was half light and half dark, so its white `1` disappeared. The folded corner at the bottom right of each card was dark where the last reset time sat. The badge is now two shades of deep blue, and the corner fold is smaller and dark only at its tip, so reset times, percentages and costs stay on light paper.
**The butterflies in the Lepidoptera panel no longer hide the text they fly over.** They drift above the cards and reached 85% opacity mid-flight, so their outlines covered reset times, the Settings button and the status line. They now peak at about 45%, so the text stays readable while they still fly over the cards.

title.zh-TW: Catppuccin 還原大小寫並標出配色
title.en: Catppuccin Restores Letter Case and Labels Each Flavor

body.zh-TW:
Catppuccin 面板過去會把 `esun-daytrade` 這類專案名硬轉成全大寫 `ESUN-DAYTRADE`，連今日總計的 `TOKENS` 都跟專案列的 `tokens` 寫法不一。現在專案名與單位都保留原本的大小寫，標籤和按鈕則維持大寫。

底部用來切換配色的四個方塊原本沒寫字，三個深色款擺在一起幾乎分不出來。現在每個方塊底下都標上了 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 與 Mocha 的名稱，選中的那一格也會特別標示出來。⟦跟把樣本盒裡沒貼標、全寫大字的色卡重新貼上原字名牌一樣，專案與配色都能一眼認出。⟧
body.en:
The Catppuccin panel used to force project names like `esun-daytrade` into all-caps `ESUN-DAYTRADE`, and even the daily total showed `TOKENS` while project rows read `tokens`. Project names and the unit now keep their original case, while labels and buttons stay uppercase.

The four squares at the bottom for switching flavors used to have no text, making the three dark ones nearly indistinguishable side by side. Each square now has its name—Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha—labeled underneath, with the selected one highlighted. ⟦Like putting original-case name tags back onto unlabeled, all-caps color swatches in a sample box, both projects and flavors are now recognizable at a glance.⟧

items.original:
**The Catppuccin panel shows project names in their real case.** Names were forced to uppercase, so `esun-daytrade` appeared as `ESUN-DAYTRADE`, and the daily total read `TOKENS` while project rows read `tokens`. Project names and the unit now keep their case; labels and buttons stay uppercase.
**The Catppuccin flavor switcher labels each swatch.** The four squares at the bottom had no text, and the three dark flavors looked almost the same. Each square now has its name below it (Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, Mocha), and the selected one is highlighted.

title.zh-TW: 楓紅黃昏落葉與黑洞星空細節更新
title.en: Maple Dusk Fallen Leaves and Black Hole Starfield Details Updated

body.zh-TW:
楓紅黃昏面板底部的兩個角落，以前各有三片落葉擠在約 50 px 內，有的側躺倒立、還壓在卡片框線上。現在改成每角一大一小兩片，接近平放並帶淡淡陰影，落在底部卡片下方。

黑洞面板則讓 120 顆背景星星不再像靜止貼圖。以前只有 8 顆會微弱變亮，黑洞在轉但背景毫無動靜。現在有 40 顆星各自用不同速度忽明忽暗，最大的六顆亮到極點時還會閃出小小十字星芒。⟦簡直像把原本歪斜擠在角落的紙片裝飾跟不怎麼亮的背景燈泡，重新擺好位置並換上各自明滅的星燈。⟧
body.en:
In the Maple Dusk panel's two bottom corners, three fallen leaves used to crowd into about 50 px on each side, some sideways or upside down and overlapping the card border. Each corner now has two leaves—one large and one small—lying nearly flat with a soft shadow below the bottom card.

In the Black Hole panel, the 120 background stars no longer look like a static sticker. Previously only 8 stars brightened slightly, leaving the backdrop motionless while the black hole spun. Now 40 stars fade in and out at their own pace, and the six largest flash a tiny cross-shaped glint at their brightest. ⟦Think of rearranging crooked paper cutouts crammed in the corners and swapping dim background bulbs for star lights that each twinkle on their own.⟧

items.original:
**The fallen leaves in the Maple Dusk panel's bottom corners look like they landed.** Each corner had three leaves crowded into about 50 px, some turned sideways or upside down and lying across the card border. Each corner now has one large and one small leaf, lying nearly flat with a soft shadow, below the bottom card.
**The stars in the Black Hole panel twinkle.** Only 8 of 120 stars changed brightness, and only slightly, so the background looked still while the black hole turned. Now 40 stars fade in and out, each at its own pace, and the six largest flash a small four-point glint at their brightest.

title.zh-TW: 「接著上次做」會完整交接上回結尾
title.en: "Pick Up Where You Left Off" Hands Over the Full Session Ending

body.zh-TW:
換開新對話接手進度，以前交接筆記只列 Claude 做的 commit（版本存檔紀錄），你用 `!` 跑的合併、tag 與推送全漏掉。就算上個工作階段做完了，它仍叫 Claude 硬給下一步。

現在會帶上 Claude Code 的整場摘要，摘要後無新動作才用，否則改附它最後一則回覆的開頭幾句。它也會由新到舊列出成功的合併 PR（合併請求）、建立的 tag 和推送，並請 Claude 做完就直說做完了，別自己編下一步。

對話壓縮的系統文字不再被當成最新請求，Claude 忙時排隊送出的訊息也會收進來。補充說明後重送的請求只列一次，按 `/clear` 後優先接這個視窗剛清掉的那場。「沒提交的改動」改為說明目前工作目錄狀態，因為它在新對話開始時才檢查。⟦像交接班以前只抄自己經手的事，現在連對方動過的進度與結尾都寫進交接本，做完就直接結案。⟧
body.en:
When you opened a new conversation to continue your work, the handoff note used to list only the commits (saved version records) Claude made, missing every merge, tag, and push you ran with `!`. Even when the last session was already finished, it still told Claude to propose a next step.

Now it includes Claude Code's end-of-session recap when nothing happened after it, or the opening sentences of Claude's last reply otherwise. It also lists successful merged PRs (pull requests), created tags, and pushes from newest to oldest, and tells Claude to say a finished round is finished instead of inventing a next step.

Compaction system text is no longer treated as your latest request, and messages queued while Claude was busy are now included. A request resent with extra detail is listed only once, and after `/clear` it prioritizes the session this window just cleared. The "uncommitted changes" line now says it describes the current working directory, because it is checked when the new conversation starts. ⟦Just as a shift handoff used to record only what one person touched, the logbook now captures the other person's progress and how things wrapped up, closing out cleanly when the job is done.⟧

items.original: **Pick Up Where You Left Off now hands over how the last session ended.** Before this fix, the note a new conversation received listed only commits Claude made, so merges, tags and pushes you ran yourself with `!` were missing, and Claude was always told to propose a next step even when the last round was finished. The note now adds Claude Code's own end-of-session recap, used only when nothing happened after it, or else the opening sentences of Claude's last reply. It lists merged PRs, created tags and pushes that succeeded, newest first, and tells Claude to say a finished round is finished instead of inventing a next step. Claude Code's compaction text is no longer shown as your latest request, messages you queued while Claude was busy are now included, a request you resent with more detail is listed once, and after `/clear` the note picks the conversation this window just cleared. The uncommitted-changes line now says it describes the current working directory, because it is checked when the new conversation starts.

title.zh-TW: 面板新增「楓紅暮色」主題
title.en: New "Maple Dusk" panel theme

body.zh-TW:
想替每天點開的畫面換上夕陽配色，現在共有 17 款造型可挑。進到「⚙ 設定 → 更換面板」就能選到「楓紅暮色」。

這款造型在金色到紫色的夕陽裡飄著楓葉，有的落在卡片後面、有的從前面飄過。卡片本身是能透出天空的半透明紫色玻璃，底部兩角還堆著落葉。macOS 開啟「減少動態效果」後，楓葉會停住不動。
body.en:
If you want a sunset palette for the panel you open every day, there are now 17 themes to choose from. Go to "⚙ Settings → Switch Panel" to select "Maple Dusk".

This theme features maple leaves drifting across a gold-to-violet sunset, with some falling behind the cards and others floating in front. The cards themselves are translucent violet glass that lets the sky show through, with fallen leaves piled in both bottom corners. When macOS "Reduce Motion" is turned on, the leaves stop moving.

items.original: **New panel theme: Maple Dusk.** Maple leaves drift down over a gold-to-violet sunset, behind and in front of violet glass cards that let the sky show through, with small piles of fallen leaves in the bottom corners. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 17 themes. The leaves stop moving when macOS Reduce Motion is on.

title.zh-TW: Muse 退訂後會移除額度卡並加快重查
title.en: Muse removes the quota card after unsubscribing and rechecks faster

body.zh-TW:
從前帳號沒有續約，只要沒開新的 Muse 對話，usage 就不會主動重查，一直留著最後存下的舊讀數。一旦過了重置時間，額度卡、Claude Code 的額度提示和通知都會把這份舊資料當成還沒用過。

現在 usage 最多每 5 分鐘重跑一次不呼叫模型的 `muse usage --json`，平常用過 Muse 後約 5 分鐘內就會更新，不必等 30 分鐘。只要 Muse 回報帳號沒有訂閱額度，usage 就會刪掉舊紀錄、不改用 `muse exec` 呼叫模型，額度卡也隨之消失；等之後再查到額度，卡片就會重新出現。⟦從前停訂雜誌後，沒再開新刊就沒人去翻信箱，牆上還掛著上期的剩餘期數；現在會定時探頭看訂戶狀態而不拆封試讀，確認退訂就把牌子收起，續訂再掛回去。⟧
body.en:
Previously, if an account did not renew, usage would not actively recheck as long as no new Muse conversation was opened, keeping the last saved old reading. Once the reset time passed, the quota card, Claude Code's quota prompt, and notifications all treated that old data as unused.

Now usage reruns the model-free `muse usage --json` at most every 5 minutes, so after regular Muse use it updates within about 5 minutes instead of waiting 30 minutes. Whenever Muse reports that the account has no subscription quota, usage deletes the old record without falling back to calling a model with `muse exec`, and the quota card disappears; once quota is found again later, the card reappears. ⟦Previously, after canceling a magazine subscription, nobody checked the mailbox unless a new issue was opened, leaving the remaining issue count from the last issue hanging on the wall; now someone peeks at the subscriber status on a schedule without unsealing a sample copy, takes down the sign once cancellation is confirmed, and hangs it back up upon renewal.⟧

items.original: **The Muse quota card disappears once the subscription ends.** Before this fix, usage kept showing the last saved Muse quota after a subscription lapsed. Once its reset times passed, the card, the Claude Code quota line and the notifications treated that quota as unused. usage rechecked only after a new Muse conversation, so it never noticed. It now reruns the model-free `muse usage --json` at most every 5 minutes, which also brings the card up to date within about 5 minutes of using Muse instead of 30. When Muse reports that the account has no subscription allowance, usage deletes the saved quota without falling back to a `muse exec` model call, and the card disappears. It comes back once Muse reports quota again.

title.zh-TW: 各工具額度讀數與重置狀態更準確
title.en: More accurate quota readings and reset states across tools

body.zh-TW:
面板出現舊數字或 `--`，常讓人分不清額度是已重置還是沒讀到。

Codex 過了重置時間，現在比照 Claude Code 和 Antigravity 顯示 0% 與「已重置」，直到下次報出新讀數。以前這兩欄只顯示 `--`，像讀不到資料。

Muse 因 5 小時額度用完而拒絕時，現在帶有自己的檢查時間。過去沿用上一筆時間，讓卡片像過期、漏發「已用完」通知，也過早重查。

較新的 Codex Spark 讀數不再蓋掉工作階段紀錄裡的一般讀數。不同額度不再合併，一般額度的拒絕不會再顯得過期。

額度感知模式在「Claude Code 自己的額度」補上「（最後更新於…；之後可能已重置）」，舊讀數不會再像最新的。額度感知 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）更新到 1.20。

各類額度的時間與狀態分清後，看面板剩餘量不用再靠猜。
body.en:
When old numbers or `--` appear in the panel, it is often hard to tell whether a quota has reset or could not be read.

Once Codex passes its reset time, it now matches Claude Code and Antigravity by showing 0% and "Reset" until a new reading is reported. Previously, both fields only showed `--`, looking like unreadable data.

When Muse refuses a request because the 5-hour quota is used up, it now carries its own check time. Previously, it reused the previous entry's time, making the card look stale, skipping the "used up" notification, and rechecking too early.

Newer Codex Spark readings no longer overwrite general readings in session logs. Different quotas are no longer merged, so a general-quota refusal no longer looks expired.

Quota-aware mode adds "(last updated ...; it may have reset since)" to "Claude Code's own quota", so old readings no longer look current. The quota-aware hook (a small program triggered by specific events) is updated to 1.20.

With the timing and status of each quota separated clearly, checking remaining amounts in the panel no longer requires guessing.

items.original:
**A Codex window past its reset time reads 0% and Reset.** Before this fix, both its usage and its reset time showed `--`, which looked like missing data. It now matches Claude Code and Antigravity until Codex reports a new reading.
**A Muse 5-hour limit shows up as a current reading.** When Muse refused a request because the 5-hour quota was used up, usage kept the previous reading's check time. The card looked stale, the "used up" notification was skipped, and usage checked again sooner than intended. The refusal now carries its own check time.
**A newer Codex Spark reading no longer replaces the general Codex reading.** When the Codex database held a newer reading for the dedicated Spark quota, it replaced the general reading from the session logs, and a general-quota rejection looked expired. Readings for different quotas are no longer merged.
**Quota-aware mode says when Claude Code's own quota was last read.** The "Claude Code's own quota" line left out the "(last updated ...; it may have reset since)" note that the same windows carry elsewhere, so an old reading could look current. The quota-aware hook updates to 1.20.

title.zh-TW: 年度帳本與報表數字不再對不攏
title.en: Year ledger and report numbers no longer mismatch

body.zh-TW:
升級後回頭對年度明細與熱力圖，現在不用擔心舊紀錄把數字拖偏。

以前重算若跟每日快照相同，會沿用快照缺少版本的紀錄。這讓 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）修正前多算的 Antigravity 日子調不下來，現在只剩從快照重播的日子才沿用存下的版本。

年度報表以前先讀或建快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）才存快照，讓明細跟熱力圖不同步、舊資料留存 6 小時。現在會先存快照，確認過舊帳本重算也略過快取。

帳本鎖被別的程序占住太久時，報表以前改讀磁碟帳本卻漏算這次用量還存進快取。現在會在記憶體補進這些日子，也不快取不完整報表。

建不出帳本鎖資料夾時，usage 不再報錯中斷，改比照打不開鎖檔處理。

明細、熱力圖與當次用量都能真正對齊。
body.en:
When checking annual details and heatmaps after upgrading, you no longer have to worry about old records skewing the numbers.

Previously, if a recount matched the daily snapshot, it kept the snapshot's version-less record. That prevented Antigravity days overcounted before the token (the text unit AI processes and bills for) fix from being lowered, whereas now only days replayed from the snapshot keep the stored versions.

Previously, the year report read or built its cache before saving the snapshot, causing the details and heatmap to go out of sync and keeping old data for 6 hours. Now it saves the snapshot first, and verified recounts of outdated ledger days also skip the cache.

When another process held the ledger lock for too long, the report previously fell back to reading the ledger on disk, omitted this run's usage, and still saved that to the cache. Now it adds those days in memory and does not cache incomplete reports.

When usage cannot create the ledger lock folder, it no longer stops with an error and instead handles it the same way as a lock file it cannot open.

Details, heatmaps, and current-run usage now truly align.

items.original:
**An Antigravity day that was counted too high can now be lowered in the year ledger.** Before this fix, when a fresh recount matched the daily snapshot, usage kept the snapshot's missing record of which counting version produced each day. A day saved before the token-counting fix therefore stayed too high after upgrading. Only days replayed from the snapshot now keep the stored versions.
**The year report no longer shows two totals for the same day.** The report read or built its cached year before saving the new snapshot, so the detail showed the corrected total while the heatmap showed the old one, and that old year stayed cached for 6 hours. The snapshot is now saved first, and a verified recount of an outdated ledger day skips the cache.
**The year report includes this run's activity even when the ledger is busy.** If another process held the ledger lock for too long, the report fell back to the ledger on disk without the days counted in this run, then cached that incomplete result. usage now adds those days in memory and does not cache the incomplete report.
**usage no longer stops with an error when it cannot create the ledger's lock folder.** It now handles this the same way as a lock file it cannot open.

title.zh-TW: 修復精簡模式不再用舊 hook 蓋掉新版
title.en: Repairing Token Saver no longer overwrites newer hooks with older ones

body.zh-TW: 之前提示檔或設定項目不見了，usage 修補精簡模式會直接拿 app 內附的腳本硬蓋過去，害你自己裝好的新版 hook 反而被退回舊版。現在只有腳本不見或版本較舊時才會替換，其餘只補回缺漏的部分，做法跟修復續談 hook 一樣。
body.en: Previously, when a prompt file or settings entry was missing, repairing Token Saver in usage overwrote things directly with the scripts bundled in the app, downgrading newer hooks you had installed yourself. Now a script is replaced only when it is missing or older, while everything else only has the missing parts restored, the same way the resume hook is repaired.

items.original: **Repairing Token Saver no longer replaces a newer hook with an older one.** When a prompt file or settings entry was missing, usage overwrote the installed Token Saver hooks with the copies bundled in the app, even if the installed ones were newer. usage now replaces a script only when it is missing or older, and restores just the missing parts, the same way it repairs the resume hook.

title.zh-TW: 匯出與重開報表的表格標示更清楚
title.en: Clearer table labels when exporting and reopening reports

body.zh-TW:
整理報表匯出存檔，或是重新打開舊報表核對花費，表格上的資訊現在不會漏掉或寫錯。

遇到花費未知的專案，CSV 匯出會寫成破折號，跟模型列一樣。以前會寫成 0.00 讓人誤以為免費，現在 app 直接匯出或存下報表裡的匯出都改過來了。

用「全部」這類日期捷徑匯出的報表，重新打開會直接還原原本的捷徑和歷史說明，不再變成手動選日期範圍。隱藏專案名稱匯出的報表，重開時日期欄也不會再是空的。

模型表裡 Antigravity 的新 Gemini 4 Neon 模型，以前會列出完整 ID，現在跟其他模型一樣改用簡稱「Neon 4」。

以後把報表匯出來對帳或傳給別人看，花費、日期條件跟模型名稱都不會再走樣。
body.en:
Whether exporting reports to save or reopening old reports to check spending, table information will no longer be missing or wrong.

For projects with unknown cost, CSV exports now write "—", the same as model rows. Previously they wrote 0.00, making them look free; both direct app exports and exports inside saved reports now fix this.

Reports exported with a date shortcut like "All" now reopen with the original shortcut and its history note restored instead of turning into a manual date range. Reports exported with hidden project names also no longer have empty date fields when reopened.

In the model table, Antigravity's new Gemini 4 Neon models previously listed their full IDs and now use the short name "Neon 4", like the other models.

From now on, when you export reports to reconcile expenses or share with others, costs, date criteria, and model names will no longer be distorted.

items.original:
**CSV exports show "—" for a project whose cost is unknown.** They used to write 0.00, which read as free. Both the app's export and the export inside a saved report now write "—", the same as model rows.
**An exported report reopens with the same date shortcut.** A report exported from a shortcut such as All reopened as a manual date range, without the shortcut and its history note. A report exported with hidden project names reopened with empty date fields. The export now stores the shortcut and restores it.
**Reports show Gemini 4 Neon by its short name.** The model table listed Antigravity's new Gemini 4 Neon models by their full IDs; they now read "Neon 4", like the other models.

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧

items.original:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

items.original:
Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)

title.zh-TW: `gh` 可改用會自動續期的登入憑證（預覽）
title.en: `gh` can sign in with auto-refreshing credentials (preview)

body.zh-TW:
一般用 `gh` 登入 GitHub，拿到的 token（證明你身分的授權令牌）發下來就不會過期。現在可以改選會過期的 OAuth 憑證：`gh` 會存一把短效的 access token，另配一把會輪替的 refresh token（專門用來換新令牌的憑證）。access token 需要時會自動換新，你不必重新登入。⟦公司門禁卡改成每天自動換發的臨時卡，以前一張卡用到離職，現在卡片天天換新，你照樣每天刷卡進門。⟧這是預覽功能，要自己選擇開啟。只想這一次登入用它，打：

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

想以後每次登入都優先用它，打：

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```
body.en:
Normally, signing in to GitHub with `gh` gives you a token (the pass that proves who you are) that never expires. You can now opt into expiring OAuth credentials instead: `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token (a credential used only to get a new pass). The access token is refreshed automatically whenever needed, so you stay signed in without authenticating again. ⟦An office swapped its permanent badges for temporary ones reissued every day: you used to keep one badge until you left the company, and now it renews daily while you still just tap in each morning.⟧ This is a preview you have to opt into. To use it for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

items.original:
## Expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens (preview)

`gh` can now sign in with expiring OAuth credentials that it refreshes automatically. When you opt in, `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token and refreshes the access token whenever it is needed, so you stay signed in without having to authenticate again.

To opt in for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

title.zh-TW: 用會過期的 `gh` 憑證時，查狀態、接 git 和寫腳本要注意的事
title.en: Living with expiring `gh` credentials: status, git and scripts

body.zh-TW: 開了自動續期後，想知道憑證還剩多久，就打 `gh auth status`：它會顯示憑證能不能續期、access token 何時到期。它和 `gh auth token` 都會在需要時自動續期。github.com 和 GHE.com 支援這種 token，其他主機會退回一般不過期的 token。git 走 HTTPS 的話，建議用 git 2.46 以上，並執行 `gh auth setup-git`，讓 `gh` 當 git 的 credential helper（替 git 提供登入資料的程式）。這樣 git 不會把憑證留到過期之後。⟦跟鮮奶一樣，以前能囤一箱慢慢喝，現在得隨喝隨買。⟧腳本和擴充別把 `gh auth token` 的輸出存起來，每次要用都重新執行它；透過 `GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 給的 token 則永遠不會續期。
body.en: Once expiring credentials are on, you may want to know how long yours has left. `gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires, and both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` refresh the access token automatically when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token. If git talks to GitHub over HTTPS, the advice is to use git 2.46 or newer and run `gh auth setup-git` so `gh` acts as git's credential helper (the program that hands git its sign-in details). That way git does not cache the credential past its lifetime. ⟦Treat it like fresh milk: you could once stock up a crate and drink it slowly, and now you buy it as you need it.⟧ So scripts and extensions should not store the output of `gh auth token`; run it again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

items.original:
`gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires. Both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` automatically refresh the access token when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token.

If you use HTTPS as your git protocol, we advise using git 2.46 or newer and letting `gh` act as your git credential helper by running `gh auth setup-git`. This way `gh` serves and refreshes the expiring credential for git, and git does not cache it past its lifetime.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Expiring access tokens should not be cached. Scripts and extensions that store the output of `gh auth token` will eventually hold an expired token, so run `gh auth token` again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

For more information, see [Authenticating with GitHub CLI](https://docs.github.com/github-cli/github-cli/authenticating-with-github-cli#using-expiring-refreshable-tokens).

title.zh-TW: 新指令 `gh issue artifact`，在終端機管理 issue 的附件文件（私人預覽）
title.en: New `gh issue artifact` manages issue artifacts from the terminal (private preview)

body.zh-TW:
規劃一個新功能時，你可能想把規劃書、流程圖或網頁原型直接掛在 GitHub issue（記錄待辦與問題的討論串）上。`gh issue artifact` 把 issue artifacts 帶到命令列，提供 `list`、`view`、`create`、`edit`、`download`、`delete` 六個指令，例如：

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦替每張工單配一個專屬資料夾，規劃書和原型都收在裡面，還記得每一版，想退回第 5 版也行。⟧artifacts 也能用 GitHub 網址指定，Markdown 文件可以用 `--attach` 附上圖片和影片。這是私人預覽，只有加入預覽的使用者和組織能用，而且只對加入預覽的儲存庫有效；申請方式在官方的預覽公告討論串。
body.en:
When planning a new feature, you may want to hang the plan, a flow chart or a web prototype right on a GitHub issue (the thread that tracks a task or problem). `gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line with six commands, `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download` and `delete`, for example:

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦Give every work ticket its own folder that holds the plan and the prototype and remembers every version, so rolling back to version 5 is easy.⟧ Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents take image and video attachments with `--attach`. This is a private preview: only users and organizations enrolled can use it, and the commands work only for repositories in the preview; access instructions are in the official preview announcement discussion.

items.original:
## Manage issue artifacts with `gh issue artifact` (private preview)

`gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line. Users and organizations enrolled in the private preview can use the `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download`, and `delete` commands to manage issue artifacts.

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents support image and video attachments with `--attach`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Issue artifacts are in private preview. These commands only work for repositories enrolled in the preview. See the [Issue Artifacts private preview announcement and feedback discussion](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/205881) for access instructions and to share feedback.
